name: init
title: DX Design System — init
description: Installs DX tokens (CSS variables for 3 brands × 4 color modes × 2 densities, Tailwind v4 theme, shadcn/ui aliases), the cn() helper and fonts. Install this first. Set <html data-brand data-theme data-density> to switch.
docs: DX installed. Set <html data-brand="default" data-theme="light" data-density="comfortable">. Docs: https://dx-design-system.vercel.app/start/getting-started/
